title: A Tiny direct message puts 1 on the Linux launcher entry and reading it clears it

not_applicable.windows: The count is drawn on the taskbar button there already; the launcher entry is a freedesktop signal with no Windows equivalent.
not_applicable.macos: The count is drawn on the Dock icon there already; the launcher entry is a freedesktop signal with no macOS equivalent.
not_applicable.android: A phone has no desktop launcher entry, and no session bus to speak one on.
not_applicable.ios: A phone has no desktop launcher entry, and no session bus to speak one on.
